reviews.text: Tina and Ginger thank you for all the love and support you've shown me over the years, but now that they're going through a difficult time, I have to thank you for the care and affection you're giving my little ones. When things are done from the heart, it shows. Monica, you're exceptional, and your team even more so!
I've been taking my dog ​​there for a while now and we're very happy, highly recommended, thank you!
One of the best places to care for and pamper dogs, 100% recommended, 100% professional

First and last time!!!

I made an appointment because I thought it would be a place where they would treat my dog ​​better, but I ended up realizing it was the worst decision.

They have a WhatsApp number, but they never answer, and as for the haircut, it was nothing special. For a long time, I took him to the groomer at Monjuït by Lluïsa Royo, and they always did a great job, but I wanted to try something closer to home, and it was a mistake.

I thought that, being more expensive, the service would be better, but it definitely wasn't. 👎🏼👎🏼

Monica is wonderful, with a big heart and very generous. I take my cobberdog there, and people stop me in the street to ask which groomer I go to. That says it all. Plus, my dog ​​has a fantastic time with Monica and her team because he plays and interacts with other dogs.

I have a 6-month-old Australian Cabberdog and I loved how they did his haircut, even though he had a lot of knots and his hair was very long from the summer and being at daycare. A very pleasant experience. I'll be back.
I've recently started taking my dog ​​there and they treat him wonderfully! The staff is super attentive and the place is set up so you feel safe when leaving your pet!

TERRIBLE EXPERIENCE, NOT RECOMMENDED AT ALL

I'll start with the most important thing: Monica is arrogant and has no manners when speaking to her clients.

She should get proper training before opening a business because she has no idea how to care for your dog. Anyway, I don't plan on going back there, and I'll warn other owners in the neighborhood not to go either.

Paying €80 and not getting a haircut that's even as premium as they advertise is a waste of money. I can cut my dog ​​better at home.

Anyway, I hope they see my review because it's important that they know this before they consider going there.
My dog ​​turned out spectacular!
Everything perfect
Jack left feeling very happy and looking very handsome; it's clear he was treated wonderfully. Highly recommended! We'll be back, bien sûr!
I took my poodle there and I loved it! Monica is a true professional and you can tell she loves her job. The shop is beautiful and has very exclusive accessories. You have a new customer, Holly! 🐶 …

I'm delighted with Monica.
I took my dog, who was traumatized after a previous groomer's visit, and I left feeling incredibly happy with the haircut, the hygiene, and the service. She also gave me excellent advice on oral hygiene and dealing with the eye discharge.
A true professional, thank you, Monica!

We've been to the veterinary center many times without your advice, and we've been receiving treatment for several years now... because our dog has problems. And since you don't want to do your job properly, you try to change the subject in every way. What do the problems we're treated at the clinic have to do with your inability to do your job properly???? They didn't brush our teeth at all... the haircut is just awful... and when we asked you to just fix our dog's face a little (since he can't have hair in his eyes; he has an eye problem after being hit by a cat), instead of silently admitting your mistakes, you tell me where I should take my dog. No one asked for your advice. Just do your job silently!!!!!!!

Besides knowing how to cut hair and leave them looking gorgeous and perfectly groomed, Mónica and Júlia are loving and charming with dogs. It's clear they're passionate about their work. They offer advice and alert us if they suspect any illness or symptoms that might require a visit to the vet. We've been taking Lamby to Mum's Dogs for a few years now, and our little dog tries to drag us inside every time we walk by. We might make mistakes, but dogs don't!
Bimba and Olivia couldn't be happier when it's time for their grooming appointments. Monica and Julia are incredibly professional and treat the dogs like they're their own. Thank you, ladies!

Mónica Costantini, from Mum’s Dog, has been my furry daughter Chloé’s groomer for 9 years.
Words can’t describe how much I trust her.
Chloé goes to her salon every Friday and has an exceptional relationship with her and her entire team… I can only recommend her salon without hesitation, which is what I usually do.

I❤️Mónica 🐾
Fantastic!!!!! Her service was excellent and very caring, my dog ​​is delighted and so am I!!!!!
Excellent professionals, they leave your pets spotless, and they're wonderful to deal with. Whenever we pass by, our pets always want to come in, which is a sign that they're happy there.

Excellent professionals, exquisite service, and in addition to their excellent work, they treat our pets with great care.
I give them a 10 in every way.

I took my dog ​​to this groomer, they cut his hair, but my dog ​​is missing an eye; the cat bleached it white, and this eye needs to be opened every day. Until the day I took my dog ​​there, I kept it open, but during the haircut, my dog's eye opened up terribly. They didn't cut his face the way I asked, and they also complained that I didn't take good care of him.
Very bad salon, terrible customer service, they don't know how to treat customers. We paid for a haircut and they didn't even cut half our hair. So, everything was terrible.
They come out looking beautiful and happy.
Fantastic place for grooming dogs!
